git.description: Git version control CLI. All tools operate on the working directory of the go-magic process; tools are read-only unless noted.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show the working tree status: staged/unstaged changes, untracked files, and the current branch. Safe to run anywhere.

tools.name: log
tools.description: Show recent commit history, one line per commit with hash, decorations and relative date.

params.name: count
params.description: How many commits to show. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Show unstaged changes in tracked files (git diff). Use this to review what would be committed.

tools.name: diff_staged
tools.description: Show changes already staged for the next commit (git diff --staged).

tools.name: branch_list
tools.description: List all local and remote branches with their latest commit (git branch -a -v).

tools.name: show
tools.description: Show one commit's full message and diff (git show).

params.name: revision
params.description: Commit hash, branch name, or ref expression such as HEAD~1.

tools.name: commit
tools.description: Commit all tracked-file changes with the given message (git commit -am). Requires user approval; untracked files are not included.

params.name: message
params.description: Commit message. Write it in the repository's usual language and style.
